purpose: Preserve original field producers exactly; no decoded/raw normalization or source-identity assertion.
textHelper: text(n) is source.slice(n.start,n.end) using JavaScript UTF16 offsets when n is present, null otherwise. These slices preserve actual escapes/BOM/text, not n.name. Nonnull id/left/arg fields use raw text.

fileTopLevelDeclarations.name: text(n.id), raw exact identifier OR destructuring pattern slice
n.id.name, Acorn decoded Identifier.name (escaped identifier decoded)
fileTopLevelDeclarations.nullId: If original producer would dereference null n.id (e.g. anonymous default export declaration), unexpected analyzer error => ABORT NODE_ANALYSIS; do not fabricate/drop row or silently add a new fallback.

functionsNameOrderedBranches.producer: n.id.name decoded, regardless parent binding rawname

functionsNameOrderedBranches.when: No own n.id and neither above parent case

contextTraversal.ordinaryNode: next=context,nextTop=top. Row contexts are incoming context, not current receiver or component identity. Recurse child AST nodes with computed next,nextTop,parent=n.
contextTraversal.functionNode: Compute next by ordered branches, set nextTop=false, append functions row name=next; descendants receive next. Named nested functions reset to own decoded name; anonymous labels use incoming context, without claiming lexical binding uniqueness.
contextTraversal.parentMeaning: Immediate AST parent passed by actual traversal; not a symbol resolver or arbitrary caller certificate.
contextTraversal.topFlag: Original top boolean follows recursive traversal and is disabled under function nodes; block nodes do not independently clear top. Label fileTopLevelDeclarations is retained evidence naming, not a new sound lexical scope guarantee.

otherFields.aliases.name: text(n.id) raw
otherFields.aliases.value: text(n.init) raw or null when no initializer
otherFields.call.args: Each text(n.arguments[i]) raw incl SpreadElement text
otherFields.directWriter.literalName: Actual named argument Literal.value if type string, decoded JS string (incl empty), otherwise null
otherFields.writer.target: Direct membercallee object text raw else null; expanded alias args[0] raw else null
otherFields.aliasWriter.alias: Captured aliases.name raw, equals captured call.callee; not a resolved calleeidentity
otherFields.lineAndOffsets: Acorn loc line and start/end original units; no added raw columns or spelling conversion

validationBoundary: Node actual-parser controls verify semantic producer branches against fixed source examples. Python validates shapes/budgets/correlations and original native/archive gates; no JS parsing or private normalization invented. All unknown source semantics remain OPEN.
